architecture.context: M03 derived writer attachment; M04 is sole S1 owner
architecture.hexagonal: Native main/editor → dedicated trusted guard → M03 transfer input port → M04 transfer_writer opaque handle → sole M04 owner
architecture.dependency: UI → Tauri guard → M03 → M04 input contract; never UI → filesystem/adapter
output_ports: trusted native source/target and consent observation; unavailable runtime provider
driven_adapters: M04 sole owner fixture double; native NOT RUN
architecture.state_ownership: M04 owns S1 content/history/revision/baselines/writer generation. M03 only derived attachment/candidate/preview/disclosure.
architecture.mutation: Transfer derived write attachment only; increment M04 writer generation, no document edit
architecture.transaction: Preflight native identities + target consent + generation/revision + capacity; atomic M04 transfer and source invalidation; confirmed commit distinct from delivery; unknown is Indeterminate
architecture.external_boundary: native instance registry/M04 trusted providers required

contracts.C1: Only current native main/ui-editor writer may invoke for its own binding. Target cannot claim; Viewer/remote/replaced instances denied. Existing target_window label is a selector only: trusted registry must resolve exactly one live native instance; absent/ambiguous registry fails DependencyNotReady, never label-based authority.
contracts.C2: Target consent is preexisting native/M04 trusted handshake bound to identity, generation and source/target nonce. No caller JSON consent. Exact provider interface is not approved; missing provider => DependencyNotReady(M04_OWNER_INTEGRATION).
contracts.C3: Transfer retains dirty shared S1 state and all history/baselines; no discard. Original transfer request has no discard_unsaved. Target attachment must be ready and local unsaved-state replacement requires separately observed native discard confirmation; otherwise Busy. Do not silently add a discard request field or drop target state.
contracts.C4: M04 alone linearizes writer generation increment plus derived source revocation, candidate/preview invalidation and disclosure retirement under one identity fence. Facade holds only opaque handle; no S1 move or second registry. Native atomic provider unavailable => DependencyNotReady, not sequential product implementation.
contracts.C5: No request_id: no new global dedup/exactly-once registry. Identical stale retry returns StaleOwner; no replay disclosure. Tombstones retain revoked tuple only, never old success replay. Capacity policy pending; document fixture capacity=2 only. No eviction/TTL/automatic retry.
contracts.C6: Known rollback before commit leaves old writer and all derived state unchanged. Confirmed commit with acknowledgement delivery unavailable is transferred=true/ack_state=Deferred at new generation, never ErrorUnchanged. Unknown commit => Indeterminate and retry prohibited; model cannot prove native state unchanged. Exact DTO Transfer ack_state replaces original WriterTransfer BindingProjection only in this candidate; original untouched. Owner options: adopt receipt or preserve projection with separately defined delivery authority. A receipt is not owner evidence, cannot grant target authority, and cannot be reused by UI for elevation. Operator reconciliation is proposed, not implemented.
contracts.C7: Already started install/save effects remain M04/issuer responsibility; do not cancel/ACK/resubmit them. Any late get/install/save response requires fresh exact native identity+generation+attachment observation; revoked source cannot receive even retained replay result.
contracts.C8: Keep exact seven DomainRejected variants from candidate-prepare-correction/response.schema.json carried unchanged via restricted close response. Non-object InvalidRequest uses details {field: empty string, reason: Type}; do not adopt open/get proposed rootType field. Generation exhaustion maps to typed DomainRejected RevisionOverflow (proposed choice), not a new top-level error. All additions remain PROPOSED, not adopted by scoped document PASS.

UI_schema.controls: target selector existing main/ui-editor; no caller nonce fields
UI_schema.disabled: pending or no trusted ready target
UI_schema.success: target becomes writer only after confirmed transfer; source read-only/revoked
UI_schema.error: plain diagnostic; no retry; uncertainty blocks edits pending trusted reconciliation
UI_schema.accessibility: announce handoff status without focus steal
